def info(fr):
    d={}
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('b','M','c','N','Y'):
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            d.setdefault(n['color'],[]).append((min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)))
    return d
print('before:', info(current_frame))
r=action(['LEFT'], intent='explore')
print('after LEFT:', info(last_transition.after_frame))
print('result keys:', {k:r.get(k) for k in ('no_impact','game_over','run_complete','level_completed','done','reward')})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
